candidate.title: Ink Moon Arch Glide
candidate.tagline: Fly the misty waterway through colossal stone arches toward the crescent moon.

world.basePrompt: A monochrome ink-wash landscape of a vast calm sea veiled in drifting mist. Colossal circular stone arches, crowned with pine trees, rise from the water in a receding line. Sheer cliffs with thin waterfalls flank both sides, floating rock islands hover in the pale sky, and a slender crescent moon hangs far ahead. Soft gray light, layered mountain silhouettes, and gentle ripples continue the scene forward in quiet, dreamlike stillness.

landmarks.description: The largest circular stone arch, crowned with pines, rising from the sea.
A pale crescent moon floating low over the distant water.
Two smaller stone arches receding into the mist ahead.
Sheer ink-dark cliffs with thin waterfalls flanking the waterway.

candidate.cartridgeLine: Thread the pine-crowned arches of an ink-wash sea before the mist closes in.
